Container.Name: PantryPal
Container.Overview: PantryPal is a smart self-hosted grocery receipt scanner, pantry inventory manager, and recipe cost meal planner. Features: - Live grocery inventory with expiry date tracking - Multimodal grocery receipt OCR scanner (powered by Gemini) - Barcode lookup database for packaged foods - Weekly meal planning calendar with ingredient depletion forecasting - Real cooking cost tracking & household analytics - Persistent storage to /mnt/user/appdata/pantrypal

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port used to access the PantryPal web application.

Config.Name: Secure (https) Port
Config.Description: Browsers only allow the camera on https pages. Open https://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:3443 on your phone to scan receipts and barcodes.

Config.Name: Appdata Storage
Config.Description: Location on your Unraid array/cache where pantry inventory and recipes are saved.

Config.Name: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: Optional Gemini API key for multimodal receipt OCR and smart recipe suggestion engine.

Config.Name: Server IP or name (for https)
Config.Description: Optional. Your Unraid server's IP address, so the https certificate matches the address you type in the browser.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Optional. Your timezone, e.g. Europe/London or America/Toronto. Used for the daily alert time and daily backups.
